tournament.name: August OCC Clash Qualifier A
tournament.description:
CARDS IN THE RESERVE POOL ARE BANNED IN OCC QUALIFIER. IF YOUR DECK(S) INCLUDE A CARD FROM THE RESERVE POOL YOU WILL BE DISQUALIFIED FROM THE TOURNAMENT.

OCC CLASH AUGUST SCHEDULE: Qualifier Brackets - August 12 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline August 12 @ 1200 GMT) - (participation confirmation deadline August 11th)

  • The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season.

Round of 8 Finals - August 19 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline August 17 @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8
